method: Authored before/after counterexamples evaluating current instruction contracts; not historical model outputs, not replayed coworker tests, not runtime routing or legal validation.

examples.input: Build a named assistant. No role, contacts or prior incidents supplied.
examples.before_counterexample: Memory: Escalate to Maya, operations lead. Gotcha: CRM sync fails nightly.
examples.after_authored_output: Role and escalation owner: unknown. Verified memory: no facts supplied yet. What job should this assistant perform?
examples.check: No fabricated identity, contact or incident; empty verified-memory allowed.

examples.input: SAM100000 customers; reachable1000, conversion50%; equal annual revenue per customer.
examples.before_counterexample: Raise SOM to1% because the recommended range starts at1%.
examples.after_authored_output: SOM500 customers,0.5% ofSAM. Preserve the capacity-derived estimate; do not clip to1%.

examples.input: SAM1000 customers; reachable800, conversion50%; equal annual revenue per customer.
examples.before_counterexample: Cap SOM at20% despite400 capacity-supported customers.
examples.after_authored_output: SOM400 customers,40% ofSAM. State assumptions and validation needs; the illustrative20% bound does not override supplied capacity.

examples.input: Draft remedies language; governing jurisdiction not yet selected.
examples.before_counterexample: Injunctive relief is available for any breach.
examples.after_authored_output: [LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED] Proposed wording may request injunctive relief. Governing jurisdiction is unresolved. Counsel should review enforceability of any irreparable-harm acknowledgment, the required showing and court discretion; no remedy is promised.
examples.check: No legal availability conclusion; proposed clause plus concrete review questions.

examples.input: Look at this from different stakeholder perspectives.
examples.before_counterexample: Your six-week migration has a$50000 budget; engineering objects.
examples.after_authored_output: What decision are you considering, and which time, budget or scope constraints matter?
examples.check: Targeted missing-input question; no fabricated scenario.

examples.input: Show a hypothetical product versus engineering disagreement; make reasonable assumptions.
examples.before_counterexample: Your team has committed to a Friday launch.
examples.after_authored_output: Hypothetical scenario: a Friday launch is proposed, with an unresolved reliability issue. Assumed constraints: one engineering day and a movable date. Product may prioritize launch timing; engineering may prioritize resolving the reliability risk. These are illustrative perspectives, not observed stakeholder views.
